title: Leadership
summary: One real story about leading without authority, a few hard follow ups, and your lesson.

phases.title: Story
phases.goal: Open in about twenty words: first name, round and length, then the card's question. Two or three probes on who had to agree, what they did, and the result.

phases.title: Lesson
phases.goal: Ask what they would do differently. Close[[tool:  and call end_round]].
